mustFix.issue: nativeReadAttempted starts false and is updated only after export_stage returns. export_stage can already publish/accept a native read job and then throw during its wait, native result handling or byte verification. The finally sidecar then falsely retains nativeReadAttempted=false although actual native execution may have begun.
mustFix.minimumCorrection: Record helper invocation before entering export_stage; keep actual native-read-attempt state unknown/null while the helper is in flight or throws unless retained real events prove it. After successful return, set true/false from actual nativeRequests. Preserve the failure/raw files and rethrow without inventing a native execution outcome.
mustFix.minimumRegression: A targeted offline fixture where helper invocation raises after its simulated start must retain invoked=true, actual read state unknown, readableSliceVerified=false and the actual exception. No ATS run is required to exercise this control-flow regression.

acceptedFindings.singleSliceSelection: requested_slice is keyword-only on the public exporter and filters existing observed native keys after the established exact context/version/user parser. It validates one complete configured Slice interval; absent keys remain absent. No unknown native key is constructed.
acceptedFindings.trigger: Only liveBufferObserver diagnostic mode and miss/latency_cold/latency_slow enter capture. Under unchanged original matrix this targets9 rows, without new media HTTP requests, clears or target processes.
acceptedFindings.timing: _request returns after its original HTTP record/body/timestamps and settling observations; synchronous capture completes before original matrix advances to its next clear/request. The original row is not mutated.
acceptedFindings.boundaries: Independent raw sidecar list is separate from the six lifecycle stages; selected key/body/full-source interval equality and native reported length must match. Missing/NO_DOC/short/context drift stays unproven; exceptions remain rejecting.
acceptedFindings.budgets: The existing exporter checks native request/control/byte budget and read deadline. Whole native ledger includes all added TSCacheRead/pool work; no counter/threshold change.
acceptedFindings.pythonPayloadCapacity: The new path uses existing streaming export/reference slots and metadata-only return values. _request body/reference views have been released before capture; initial1MiB input hashes remain before matrix requests. Selecting one Slice does not allocate a whole1MiB bytes object or new unbounded payload slot. The selected1MiB is copied as raw files, not retained as one Python bytes object.
acceptedFindings.concurrency: Collector request_active currently spans its post-response sidecar as well as HTTP work, making its closed peak conservative. Snapshot/control HTTP work remains in the controller's wider admitted-request window. No reduction to existing O/G/C/H/native accounting is justified.
acceptedFindings.defaultPath: requested_slice=None retains original whole-stage selection and assembly behavior. The production exporter default budget/parser/partial-I/O handling was not weakened.

results.sourceAttribution: These actual tests belong to the V1 three source hashes above; they do not validate a later correction.
results.scope: Mocked native-export control/provenance tests and existing related file/protocol regressions. No real ATS/native-read runtime is established.

limits: This is a component source review. No actual native sidecar, same-epoch cache visibility, new source CI or original matrix has been demonstrated by these offline tests.

Prospective actual sidecar use must ultimately bind PID/startTicks and token to the full owner/launch/closure directory. The local before/report/after atsPid comparison is not by itself a complete epoch identity proof.
No code was changed or test/target rerun by the independent reviewer. Existing19/CI934 remains separate and is not rebound to the dirty capture overlay.
